item.title: Watch Video: Youth Congress protests against Election Commission in Lucknow | Dynamite News
item.description: In Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh Youth Congress staged a massive protest against the Election Commission, launching the “Vote Chor Gaddi Chhod” campaign. Demonstrators marched from the party office to the EC, raising slogans against alleged bias. Tensions escalated with police barriers and scuffles, resulting in several arrests.

item.title: Karnataka power battle intensifies as Siddaramaiah refuses to step down; Shivakumar demands ‘promised rotation’ | Dynamite News
item.description: Karnataka is witnessing an intense political crisis as Chief Minister Siddaramaiah and Deputy CM D.K. Shivakumar appear locked in a power tussle over a reported “2.5-year CM rotation formula.” Shivakumar’s public reminder about “keeping one’s word” triggered a strong counter from Siddaramaiah, who signaled he has no intention of stepping down.

item.title: The MTA Speaks: MP Bureaucracy in turmoil after IAS officer’s remark sparks statewide outrage | Dynamite News
item.description: A major controversy has erupted in Madhya Pradesh after senior IAS officer Santosh Verma made a statement that was widely seen as offensive to the Brahmin community. The remark triggered intense public outrage, forcing the state government to issue a notice and seek clarification. Read an exclusive analysis by veteran journalist Manoj Tibrewal Aakash.

item.title: Delhi AQI: NCR cities in crisis as pollution soars; Govt takes action | Dynamite News
item.description: Delhi-NCR is facing severe air pollution as AQI levels surpass 400 in multiple localities, plunging the region into the “severe” category. Stagnant winds, smog, and seasonal factors have worsened the air quality across Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, and Ghaziabad.

item.title: Delhi: Gangster arrested over shooting plot at Kapil Sharma’s Café; Linked to Goldy Dhillon gang | Dynamite News
item.description: Delhi Police has arrested gangster Bandhu Man Singh, linked to the Goldy Dhillon gang, for planning a shooting at Kapil Sharma’s Canada-based café, ‘Kaps Café’. Singh was found with a pistol and cartridges.

item.title: RBI revises home loan rules, cheaper loans ahead; Full details here | Dynamite News
item.description: RBI has revised rules for floating-rate home loans, allowing banks to reduce interest rates based on improved credit scores without waiting three years. Existing and new customers can now apply for rate cuts as soon as their credit score improves.

item.title: Dubai and India Gold Prices rise again today; Check rates here | Dynamite News
item.description: Gold prices are rising in Dubai and India due to expectations of a US Fed rate cut in December and strong spot demand. In Dubai, 24-carat gold trades at Dh500.25, while in India it is ₹12,846 per gram. MCX gold and silver futures also saw gains.

item.title: Kapil Sharma Canada Cafe Firing: Delhi Police arrests mastermind Bandhu Maan Singh in Ludhiana | Dynamite News
item.description: The first firing at Kaps Cafe occured on 19 July just a week after on 7 August, there was a second firing at the same location. And in October Cafe was again targeted. In these firing incidents nobody was injured. However, the glass windows of the Cafe were broken. After the incidents the Cafe remained closed for several days.
